review_method: Separate failure-oriented rereading of the pinned original JPEG after the first draft was written and committed, within the SAME GPT-6 conversation/context. The check treats words as potential errors and source segmentation as adversarial assumptions; it does not supply a second isolated blind text or a third independent judge. Neither original PDF OCR nor external edited copies were used.
